summary: iter484.2 Gate 2 tested. Backend security masking works perfectly: raw reserve_price is NEVER exposed on /api/vehicles, /api/vehicles/{id}, or /api/vehicle-multi-lot-auctions/{id}. All 33 backend tests pass (10 gate2 masking unit tests + 23 settlement regression) + 6 new API-level integration tests pass. UI mostly works: browse cards (3 chips), multi-lot event (3 badges: none/not_met/met), storage regression, and multi-item regression ALL PASS with no dollar amounts leaked. HOWEVER: VehicleDetailPage.js crashes with 'ReferenceError: reserveMet is not defined' on ALL 3 seed vehicles — the error boundary shows 'Something went wrong'. Root cause: reserveMet is destructured from useVehicleBidding only inside the BiddingPanel subcomponent (line 268), but the parent VehicleDetailPage (line 1086+) references it at line 1232 without defining it in its own scope.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: reserveMet is not defined at line 1232 — page crashes to ErrorBoundary for ALL vehicle detail routes (no-reserve, reserve-met, reserve-not-met). reserveMet is only destructured inside BiddingPanel subcomponent (line 268), but the outer VehicleDetailPage function scope (starts line 1086) never destructures it before using it at line 1232. Trust-badges row VehicleReserveBadge chip therefore never renders.

action_items: FIX VehicleDetailPage.js: Either (a) destructure `reserveMet` from useVehicleBidding at the top of the VehicleDetailPage function (around line 1116) similar to BiddingPanel line 264-270, OR (b) replace `reserveMetRealtime={reserveMet}` at line 1232 with `reserveMetRealtime={vehicle?.reserve_met}` (this loses realtime but avoids the crash). Recommended: call useVehicleBidding at VehicleDetailPage scope and pass the resulting reserveMet down; or simply use vehicle.reserve_met since server-side already reflects that state via the masking layer.

Note: URL paths in the review request used `/vehicles/:id` and `/vehicle-multi-lot-auctions/:id` for frontend, but actual routes are `/vehicle-auctions/:id` and `/vehicle-multi-lot/:eventId`. Test used the correct routes.
critical_code_review_comments: reserveMet undefined bug in VehicleDetailPage.js line 1232 is a straightforward regression from Gate 2 wiring — the new <VehicleReserveBadge variant='chip' reserveMetRealtime={reserveMet}/> was pasted into the Trust Badges row (parent scope) but reserveMet only exists in the BiddingPanel child scope.

Console PageError 'Please call Stripe() with your publishable key. You used an empty string.' appears on every page — unrelated to Gate 2 but worth flagging to main agent (Stripe publishable key not injected in frontend env). Not gating for this task since guardrails exclude Stripe.
SECURITY masking is water-tight: raw JSON body of every buyer endpoint verified to contain neither the reserve_price key nor its string token.

rca of the issue: REPRO: Open /vehicle-auctions/iter484-2-gate2-no-reserve (or any of the 3 seed IDs). Page renders ErrorBoundary 'Something went wrong'. Dev details shows 'reserveMet is not defined'. Console: 'ReferenceError: reserveMet is not defined at VehicleDetailPage (src_pages_vehicles_VehicleDetailPage_js.chunk.js:10912:35)'. RCA: In /app/frontend/src/pages/vehicles/VehicleDetailPage.js the BiddingPanel subcomponent (line 220) destructures reserveMet from useVehicleBidding at line 264-270 — this is fine for the sidebar card usage at line 501. However, the new Gate 2 wiring at line 1229-1233 placed a second <VehicleReserveBadge variant='chip' reserveMetRealtime={reserveMet}/> inside the OUTER VehicleDetailPage component (defined at line 1086) which does not call useVehicleBidding and therefore has no reserveMet symbol in scope. MITIGATION: (recommended) Add `const { reserveMet: outerReserveMet } = useVehicleBidding(vehicle?.id, !!vehicle, vehicle);` near the top of VehicleDetailPage after `vehicle` state is defined, and pass outerReserveMet to line 1232 — OR simpler, replace with `reserveMetRealtime={vehicle?.reserve_met}` since the masked backend already emits reserve_met correctly.
